title: NASA-UAP-D028, Apollo 17 Crew Medical Debriefing, 1972
what_is_it: Audio recording of a post-mission crew medical debriefing (Apollo 17), released as a video/audio file.
interpretation_warnings: No text could be extracted from the file (likely audio-only or scanned/OCR-poor); all facts derive from war.gov catalogue metadata, not from the recording's content.

The 'light flash phenomena' is a documented biological effect of cosmic radiation on the retina, not evidence of an external unidentified aerial phenomenon, despite the file's inclusion in a UAP collection.
Individual crew members are not identified in the available metadata.
This is only segment 1 of 2; full context requires the companion file NASA-UAP-D029.
